Query Salesforce CRM as the signed-in user

Source: R/backend__salesforce.R
oauth_db_salesforce_api.Rd

Run SOQL queries and inspect objects through Salesforce's REST API. Salesforce applies the visitor's object, field and record permissions.

Usage

oauth_db_salesforce_api(
  authorization,
  instance_url,
  api_version = "64.0",
  target = NULL,
  required_scopes = "api",
  min_valid_for = 60,
  timeout = 300,
  ca_bundle = NULL,
  session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain()
)

Arguments

authorization

auth$connection from a shinyOAuth server module, without parentheses. To select a saved authorization, pass a function that calls auth$connection(id).

instance_url

Trusted HTTPS origin of your Salesforce org, such as "https://example.my.salesforce.com". Use the org URL, not a Lightning URL.

api_version

Salesforce REST API version without v, default "64.0".

target

Token target name in the shinyOAuth client. NULL uses its default token, including for clients without named targets.

required_scopes

Additional permissions to check before use. Request consent and set the client's permission requirements in shinyOAuth.

min_valid_for

Minimum remaining token lifetime, in seconds, when obtaining a token. Use 0 to accept any unexpired token.

timeout

Total seconds allowed for an operation, including polling, result pages and any permitted refresh retry.

ca_bundle

Optional path to a trusted CA certificate bundle.

session

Shiny session. Inferred when the helper is created in server().

Value

An R6 client with these methods:

  • $query(soql, include_deleted = FALSE, raw = FALSE) fetches all result pages and returns a data frame. include_deleted = TRUE uses QueryAll. raw = TRUE returns combined native records and totalSize, including the count for SELECT COUNT().

  • $objects() returns the native sObject discovery response.

  • $describe(object) returns native object metadata.

Details

Create the client inside server(). Each operation pins its starting authorization and obtains a current access token before each request. Responses arriving after sign-out, account changes or permission loss are discarded. A GET can retry once after HTTP 401 with a renewed token.

Pagination accepts only query-locator paths for the configured API version on the configured org. Redirects are refused. timeout covers all pages of an operation. Results are collected synchronously in R memory.

Top-level Salesforce attributes metadata is omitted from data frames. Relationships and child queries remain list columns. Ordinary JSON numbers use R numeric values; large integers remain strings. An empty result has no column metadata; use $describe() when you need field types. SOQL is supplied as written, without SQL parameter interpolation.

See also

oauth_db_salesforce_client(), oauth_db_salesforce_data_cloud_api(). vignette("salesforce", package = "shinyOAuthDB").

Other platform API clients: oauth_db_bigquery_api(), oauth_db_clickhouse_api(), oauth_db_cratedb_api(), oauth_db_databricks_api(), oauth_db_fabric_api(), oauth_db_libsql_api(), oauth_db_opensearch_api(), oauth_db_oracle_ords_api(), oauth_db_postgrest_api(), oauth_db_salesforce_data_cloud_api(), oauth_db_supabase_api()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
crm <- oauth_db_salesforce_api(
  auth$connection, "https://example.my.salesforce.com"
)
output$rows <- shiny::renderTable({
  crm$query("SELECT Id, Name FROM Account LIMIT 20")
})
} # }
